The United States fought World War I while facing the Spanish flu pandemic.
The American people have the capacity to innovate and adapt.
Humanity as a whole has the capacity to innovate and adapt.
We can overcome current challenges as a nation.

assumptions.text: Past resilience demonstrates future capability.
Historical examples of national crisis response validate current optimism.
The audience values historical precedent as evidence for hope.
The speaker's credibility depends on invoking shared national history.
Adaptation requires effort but is achievable despite difficulty.
